strategic_narrative.summary: Consolidates Sample Registration (Phase 1), Drying, Grinding & Dry Soil Prep (Phase 2), and Organic Chemistry Prep (Phase 3) into a single lean facility at Unit 1, Science Park, SomewhereintheUK.

consolidated_phases.name: Sample Registration
consolidated_phases.description: Single bottom-right sample intake into a 300 x 400 cm sorting zone feeding segregated Waters and Soils registration lanes.

consolidated_phases.name: Drying, Grinding & Dry Soil Prep
consolidated_phases.description: Retained Grinding and Drying rooms linked via Prep Corridor into Sulphide Prep, double-deck Soil rollers, and Rapid Moisture testing.

consolidated_phases.name: Organic Chemistry Prep
consolidated_phases.description: Point-of-use 50 x 50 cm benchtop fume hoods on hybrid splitting stations (S8, S11), shakers/vialling row, TOC extraction, and Waters testing stations.

lean_principles: One-piece flow along continuous roller conveyors (Waters single-deck; Soils dual-deck separating dry and wet/prepared trays)
Strict one-directional flow from bottom-right intake (Main Entrance) to top-wall dual outbound dispatch doors (Exit 1 Soils, Exit 2 Waters)
Physical sample segregation from initial sort via a 240 cm central walkway with zero cross-traffic

demolished: Old Team Leaders Office (Main Hall bottom-right)
Dividing wall between Preparation Managers Office and Lean Office
retained: Grinding Room (2 Grinders + 1 Grinding Fume Hood)
External Cold Storage (1,800 x 10,800 mm outside left wall)
upgraded_and_new: Main Hall redeveloped into 10 Waters stations + 15 Soils (3x5) stations + 3 roller conveyors + Logistics wall
Sulphide Island widened to 1.50 x 5.40 m (+3 PCs, 8 total Sulphide PCs + Post-Grind Scan PC)
Toilets upgraded to 4 W/C cubicles + washbasins/boiler alcove + rear access corridor
On-Hold Storage fitted with 2x 400 cm 6-tier racks (60 cm path) + 500 L tall fridge
Merged Customer Service / Admin Office (8 dual-screen workstations) with direct door into Modernized Canteen
